steps.name: zoom_200_and_limitations_audit
actions: Probe CDP Emulation.setPageScaleFactor(2.0)
Observe layout metrics under headless browser

objective_results.reason: CDP headless automation lacks native browser-level zoom reflow API (Ctrl++ equivalent). Emulation.setPageScaleFactor applies visual pinch-zoom rather than desktop layout zoom reflow, and CSS zoom is prohibited by directive as synthetic. Therefore true 200% browser zoom reflow is declared unproven/degraded rather than an invented PASS.
